svg.title: The leader floor, Thursday afternoon
svg.desc: The editorial floor of a newspaper with the paper's name on the wall, a bound archive volume, a framed first column, an unsigned leader proof on a screen and an empty chair at the conference table.

g.text: Twelve things to find. Three carry a name and two deliberately do not.
the paper's name on the wall
the style guide, open at page 9
a reader's letter, and a map with one ward circled
the style guide, open at page 9
the empty chair - the writer of tomorrow's leader
the columnist - nineteen years under her own name
